The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbf1578546653fc5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each fixed environment, the input and output spin fields of the torus construction, or of the local construction with prescribed old exterior field variables, can be coupled so that they agree outside squares of radius 5s′ about marked parent centers. The marks are mutually independent conditional on the environment, independent of the output Gibbs sample, and have local environmental parameters pj satisfying pj ≤ min    1, CL X i: ∥si−s′j∥∞≤Ks′ ∥fi∥    . (3.8) For any P ≥ 1 and a stationary field with a finite Pth environmental moment, Epj ≤ CL(E∥f0∥P )1/P . These conclusions hold uniformly over the old exterior assignments in the local implementation of Corollary 3.4.
